detected.detail: reflection gate: NFR-F1-durability-migrations requires each stock record carry an unmodifiable created_at timestamp and actor set by the service and stored immutably by the model, but no test in this story's list verifies that. T12 (invariant_id PI4-migration-reversible) only exercises migration downgrade/upgrade + seeded-row survival; T9 (PI2-required-fields-not-null) round-trips only sku/location/quantity/inventory_code. S1 is the only story that creates stock_records (S2/S3 are read-only), so if the audit-field clause isn't tested here it is never tested anywhere in this feature. Add a fitness test asserting a filed record's created_at/actor are service-set and remain unchanged across a refile (AC3 upsert).
